description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing organizations, including actions for creating, viewing, updating, deleting, and leaving organizations. It handles HTTP requests, interacts with models, and manages access control for organization-related operations.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Organization
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for organization management, extending Coocook::Controller.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new organization, validating the name and checking availability before creation.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures the organization by name from the URL, setting it in the stash, or detaching with an error if not found.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays organization details, including users and projects, with access control for viewing projects.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates organization details such as description and display name based on POST parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the organization and redirects to the appropriate page based on user capabilities.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Allows a user to leave an organization, removing their association.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect to the organization's show page.
